Harris County contains Houston — the fourth-largest U.S. city and the nation's energy capital — plus the Port of Houston and the Texas Medical Center. Houston famously has no zoning: land use is governed by deed restrictions parcel by parcel, and post-Harvey floodplain rules make flood-zone and drainage context decisive for nearly every deal.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: August 21, 2026
